memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for fatigue and poor sleep.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports persistent low energy, daytime sleepiness, and difficulty falling asleep despite feeling tired.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 55 kg, height 1.55 m gives BMI 22.9 (normal). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams are unremarkable; pallor noted on conjunctiva.
IMPRESSION: Iron‑deficiency anaemia likely contributing to fatigue; insomnia worsened by age‑related changes. Annual fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar ordered as per protocol.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order Hb, ferritin, MCV, TSH, Insomnia Severity Index, lipid profile and glucose. Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for routine follow‑up and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels slightly better energy but still reports early‑morning awakening.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82, weight 57 kg, height 1.55 m → BMI 23.7 (overweight). Advice on balanced diet and regular walking given.
IMPRESSION: Iron‑deficiency anaemia improving but still suboptimal; insomnia mild. Annual lipids and glucose checked previously; now within target except LDL slightly high.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat Hb, ferritin, MCV. Continue ferrous sulfate on alternate days, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Influenza vaccine administered today (01‑Sep‑2025). Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-11-12 at 10:30 with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for worsening fatigue and restless nights.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes increased tiredness, difficulty concentrating, and frequent awakenings.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/86, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m → BMI 24.1 (overweight). Advice on reduced salt intake and light aerobic activity reiterated.
IMPRESSION: Persistent iron‑deficiency anaemia; insomnia severity risen. Plan to increase iron supplementation and review sleep hygiene.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order Hb, ferritin, MCV, TSH, ISI. Change ferrous sulfate to 200 mg OD. Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, increase trazodone to 75 mg HS. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for routine review of anaemia and sleep.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports steadier energy, fewer night awakenings, but still desires better sleep.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84, weight 57 kg, height 1.55 m → BMI 23.7 (overweight). Advice on Mediterranean‑style diet and 30‑minute walks.
IMPRESSION: Haemoglobin approaching normal; ferritin still low‑normal. Insomnia improved but residual. Annual lipid and glucose checked; within targets.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat Hb, ferritin, MCV. Keep ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 75 mg HS. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for autumn influenza vaccination and check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, reports good energy and sleep quality.
EXAMINATION: BP 135/80, weight 56 kg, height 1.55 m → BMI 23.3 (overweight). Advice on maintaining activity and hydration.
IMPRESSION: Iron stores adequate; haemoglobin stable. Insomnia Severity Index score 8 (mild). Annual lipids and glucose within normal limits.
ARRANGEMENTS: Influenza vaccine administered today (20‑Sep‑2026). Continue current meds. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Final visit for medication review before winter.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient denies new symptoms, wishes to continue current regimen.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/78, weight 55 kg, height 1.55 m → BMI 22.9 (normal). No specific diet advice needed.
IMPRESSION: Iron‑deficiency anaemia in remission; insomnia well controlled. No further labs required at this time.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 75 mg HS. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.
